question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` plus `defaultAccount`, preserve root-level configuration as the implicit default account, inherit shared root settings, and require a separate webhook port for each named bot?
rationale: The patch is technically credible and follows existing account helpers, but it establishes durable public configuration, setup, deployment, authentication, routing, and persisted-state semantics that reviewer inference cannot safely approve.

options.title: Sponsor, clean, and validate
options.body: Approve the proposed account contract, remove unrelated churn, refresh the branch, and verify legacy upgrades plus named-account isolation before merge.

options.title: Redesign the account contract
options.body: Pause this branch and specify different inheritance, webhook, or default-account semantics before implementation resumes.

options.title: Decline multi-account Teams
options.body: Close the implementation and keep Microsoft Teams single-account until a future sponsored design exists.
